user.title: Add apartment
user.description: Create one entry per apartment. Select a cumulative energy meter (Wh, kWh or MWh), not a power sensor. Initial readings and gaps are never billed. Maximum power bounds plausible meter increments.

installation.title: 1 · Installation
installation.description: Name your installation. Next come inverters, grid, battery and apartments.

apartments.title: 5 · Apartments
apartments.description: Assigned so far: {apartments}. Add each apartment with its consumption meter. Names and assignments remain editable. Then continue to the summary.

apartment.title: Apartment and meter
apartment.description: Assign the apartment's dedicated meter. All calculated points are created automatically. Editing retains its stable identity. Pausing releases the source; that load remains in the building residual. Removing does not erase stored history.

inverters.title: 2 · Inverters ({count} added)

grid.title: 3 · Grid
grid.description: Select the cumulative energy counters at the building grid connection: import from the grid and export to the grid. Use kWh/Wh/MWh, not instantaneous power.

battery.title: 4 · Battery
battery.description: Does the installation have a shared battery? Without one, continue directly to apartments.

battery_meters.title: 4 · Battery meters
battery_meters.description: Assign separate AC energy counters for charging and discharging, and enter usable capacity. These fields are only needed when a battery is installed.

pv_details.title: Optional string details
pv_details.description: Optional individual-string monitoring. Leave this empty when inverter total yields are sufficient. These readings do not add to the PV total or affect apartment allocations.

advanced.title: Advanced settings
advanced.description: Defaults normally suffice to get started. Clear a review hold only after checking the affected meters.

data.acknowledge: Sources checked: clear review hold and establish new baselines

site_menu.title: {name} · Settings
site_menu.description: Choose the section to edit. Existing assignments remain filled in. Review the summary to save your changes.

finish.title: 6 · Review and save

inverter.title: Assign inverter
inverter.description: Select the total-yield sensor for this inverter, e.g. Growatt Total Power Generation. After confirming, you can add the next inverter. String counters are not needed here.

error.meter_assigned: This meter is already assigned to another active apartment. Pause that entry first.
error.recursive_meter: SolarShare output sensors cannot be used as sources.
error.not_cumulative: Choose an energy sensor with state class total or total_increasing.
error.unsupported_unit: Supported units are Wh, kWh and MWh.
error.duplicate_meter: Assign each source only once; pause the previous apartment if needed.
error.battery_pair: Select both battery charge and discharge meters, or neither.
error.missing_sources: Select PV production, grid import and grid export meters.
error.single_site: An installation already exists. Add apartments in its configuration.
error.pv_boundary_mismatch: All summed inverter sources must use the same measurement boundary. Record DC string counters separately as string details.

abort.single_site: An installation already exists. Add apartments in its configuration.

init.title: Edit apartment and meter assignment
init.description: Totals remain with this apartment. Changing the source starts a new measurement baseline. Pause releases the meter for reassignment. Acknowledge only after checking a reset, source identity change or implausible jump; skipped energy is never recovered automatically.

data.name: Apartment name
data.paused: Pause this apartment and release its meter
data.acknowledge: I checked the source; clear the review hold and start a new baseline
